about: Prices for KamGre's estimates, read from the operators' published price lists. Every entry names its source and the day it was read. Amounts in euro cents incl. VAT. Not exact: the app always shows them as estimates.

sharing.about: Per ride for a member: freeMinutes free, then charges once the ride passes each minute ([after, cents]), then every [after, step minutes, cents] per started step, capped at capCents; maxMinutes: longest rental allowed. resetOnReturn: a new rental starts a new free period (after waitSeconds). Scooters: unlockCents + perMinuteCents per started minute.
